CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ai_runs_pkey ON public.ai_runs USING btree (id)
CREATE INDEX ai_runs_requester_history_idx ON public.ai_runs USING btree (requested_by_user_id, queued_at DESC, id)

CHECK ((failure_code IS NULL OR failure_code ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{1,80}$'::text) AND (failure_detail IS NULL OR length(failure_detail) <= 500 AND failure_detail !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND (status <> 'failed'::text OR failure_code IS NOT NULL) AND (retry_state <> 'scheduled'::text OR failure_code IS NOT NULL))

CHECK (jsonb_typeof(input_sources_json) = 'array'::text AND octet_length(input_sources_json::text) <= 65536 AND jsonb_typeof(attempt_history_json) = 'array'::text AND octet_length(attempt_history_json::text) <= 65536 AND jsonb_typeof(input_context_json) = 'object'::text AND octet_length(input_context_json::text) <= 131072 AND jsonb_array_length(attempt_history_json) <= max_attempts AND jsonb_array_length(attempt_history_json) <= attempt_count AND input_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text)

CHECK (status = 'processing'::text AND lease_owner IS NOT NULL AND length(lease_owner) >= 1 AND length(lease_owner) <= 128 AND lease_owner = btrim(lease_owner) AND lease_owner !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text AND lease_token IS NOT NULL AND lease_acquired_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND lease_expires_at > lease_acquired_at OR status <> 'processing'::text AND lease_owner IS NULL AND lease_token IS NULL AND lease_acquired_at IS NULL AND lease_expires_at IS NULL)
FOREIGN KEY (model_config_id) REFERENCES ai_model_config(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK (prompt_id ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$'::text AND prompt_version > 0 AND prompt_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND provider_envelope_version > 0 AND provider_envelope_hash ~ '^[0-9a-f]{64}$'::text AND input_schema_version > 0 AND output_schema_version > 0 AND length(policy_version) >= 1 AND length(policy_version) <= 80 AND policy_version = btrim(policy_version) AND policy_version !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text AND policy_version ~ '^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._-]{0,79}$'::text)

CHECK ((provider_response_status = ANY (ARRAY['not_dispatched'::text, 'success'::text, 'timeout'::text, 'transport_error'::text, 'rate_limited'::text, 'quota_exceeded'::text, 'client_error'::text, 'server_error'::text, 'safety_rejected'::text, 'invalid_response'::text, 'model_drift'::text, 'cancelled_no_response'::text, 'cancelled_late_response'::text, 'unknown'::text])) AND (provider_http_status IS NULL OR provider_http_status >= 100 AND provider_http_status <= 599) AND (provider_error_code IS NULL OR length(provider_error_code) <= 80 AND provider_error_code !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND (provider_request_id IS NULL OR length(provider_request_id) <= 200 AND provider_request_id !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND (provider_response_status <> 'cancelled_no_response'::text OR status = 'cancelled'::text AND cancelled_lease_token IS NOT NULL AND provider_dispatched_at IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_response_status <> 'cancelled_late_response'::text OR status = 'cancelled'::text AND cancelled_lease_token IS NOT NULL AND provider_dispatched_at IS NOT NULL AND generated_at IS NOT NULL) AND (status <> 'draft_ready'::text OR provider_response_status = 'success'::text AND actual_provider = requested_provider AND returned_model = requested_model AND failure_code IS NULL AND failure_detail IS NULL))

CHECK ((quality_rating IS NULL OR quality_rating >= 1 AND quality_rating <= 5) AND array_position(quality_labels, NULL::text) IS NULL AND quality_labels <@ ARRAY['factual_issue'::text, 'relevance'::text, 'clarity'::text, 'tone'::text, 'format'::text, 'duplication'::text, 'unsafe_claim'::text] AND cardinality(quality_labels) <= 7 AND cardinality(quality_labels) = ((quality_labels @> ARRAY['factual_issue'::text])::integer + (quality_labels @> ARRAY['relevance'::text])::integer + (quality_labels @> ARRAY['clarity'::text])::integer + (quality_labels @> ARRAY['tone'::text])::integer + (quality_labels @> ARRAY['format'::text])::integer + (quality_labels @> ARRAY['duplication'::text])::integer + (quality_labels @> ARRAY['unsafe_claim'::text])::integer) AND (quality_comment IS NULL OR length(quality_comment) <= 1000 AND quality_comment !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'::text) AND (applied_target_version IS NULL OR (target_type = ANY (ARRAY['product_draft'::text, 'content_draft'::text]))))
FOREIGN KEY (requested_by_user_id) REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK (status = 'pending'::text AND (retry_state = ANY (ARRAY['none'::text, 'scheduled'::text])) OR (status = ANY (ARRAY['processing'::text, 'draft_ready'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) AND retry_state = 'none'::text OR status = 'failed'::text AND (retry_state = ANY (ARRAY['exhausted'::text, 'not_retryable'::text])))
FOREIGN KEY (target_content_id, target_locale) REFERENCES content_localizations(content_id, locale) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (target_product_id, target_locale) REFERENCES product_localizations(product_id, locale) ON DELETE RESTRICT
FOREIGN KEY (target_revision_id) REFERENCES editorial_revisions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

CHECK (target_type = 'product_draft'::text AND target_product_id IS NOT NULL AND target_content_id IS NULL AND target_revision_id IS NULL AND target_locale = 'en'::text OR target_type = 'content_draft'::text AND target_product_id IS NULL AND target_content_id IS NOT NULL AND target_revision_id IS NULL AND target_locale = 'en'::text OR target_type = 'editorial_revision'::text AND target_product_id IS NULL AND target_content_id IS NULL AND target_revision_id IS NOT NULL AND target_locale IS NULL)

CHECK (target_type = 'product_draft'::text AND (use_case = ANY (ARRAY['seo_content_draft'::text, 'product_description_draft'::text])) OR target_type = 'content_draft'::text AND (use_case = ANY (ARRAY['seo_content_draft'::text, 'fabric_knowledge_draft'::text, 'sourcing_guide_draft'::text])) OR target_type = 'editorial_revision'::text AND (use_case = ANY (ARRAY['seo_content_draft'::text, 'fabric_knowledge_draft'::text, 'product_description_draft'::text, 'sourcing_guide_draft'::text])))

CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['draft_ready'::text, 'failed'::text, 'cancelled'::text])) = (completed_at IS NOT NULL) AND (provider_dispatched_at IS NULL OR provider_dispatched_at >= queued_at) AND (generated_at IS NULL OR provider_dispatched_at IS NOT NULL AND generated_at >= provider_dispatched_at) AND (completed_at IS NULL OR completed_at >= queued_at) AND (status <> 'draft_ready'::text OR generated_at IS NOT NULL) AND ((status <> ALL (ARRAY['draft_ready'::text, 'failed'::text])) OR generated_at IS NULL OR completed_at >= generated_at) AND (status <> 'cancelled'::text OR generated_at IS NULL OR completed_at >= generated_at OR provider_response_status = 'cancelled_late_response'::text) AND updated_at >= queued_at AND (generated_at IS NULL OR updated_at >= generated_at) AND (completed_at IS NULL OR updated_at >= completed_at) AND generation_duration_ms >= 0)

CHECK ((input_tokens IS NULL OR input_tokens >= 0) AND (output_tokens IS NULL OR output_tokens >= 0) AND (total_tokens IS NULL OR total_tokens >= 0) AND (input_tokens IS NULL OR output_tokens IS NULL OR total_tokens IS NULL OR total_tokens = (input_tokens + output_tokens)))
